attchmntText: Fusion CX Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026 for Appointment of M/S Price Waterhouse & Co Chartered Accountants LLP, as Statutory Auditor
voiceSummary: Fusion CX Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The board recommended a final dividend of Rs. 0.75 per equity share for the financial year 2025-26, subject to member approval at the ensuing Annual General Meeting. The record date for this dividend is fixed as November 27, 2026. The board also recommended the ratification of the Employee Stock Option Scheme 2023, the appointment of M/S Price Waterhouse & Co Chartered Accountants LLP as Statutory Auditor, and CS Pravin Kumar Drolia as Secretarial Auditor, all pending shareholder approval. Additionally, Mr. Rakesh Sony, Mr. Narayanan Subramaniam, and Mr. Andrew Jay Wilmott were appointed as Additional Directors, subject to member approval.

attchmntText: Fusion CX Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Press Release on the acquisition of impacx, Germany, by Fusion BPO Services Limited, a UK based wholly owned subsidiary of the Company.".
voiceSummary: Fusion CX Limited has signed a binding agreement to acquire 100% of impacx solutions GmbH, tel-inform solutions GmbH, and impacx services GmbH in Germany. The acquisition is subject to regulatory and statutory approvals. Fusion BPO Services Limited, a UK based wholly owned subsidiary of Fusion CX Limited, executed the Share Purchase Agreement effective November 1, 2026. impacx recorded about €11.9 million in revenue in 2025 and employs around 250 people. The deal adds a client base in German-speaking Europe, the impacx Data Hub, and the tel-inform virtual front-office business. impacx has served more than 270 clients and operates in eight European markets. Fusion CX Limited is making this press release available on its website.

attchmntText: Fusion CX Limited has informed the Exchange about Agreements
voiceSummary: Fusion CX Limited’s UK subsidiary, Fusion BPO Services Limited, entered a Share Purchase Agreement on November 12, 2026, to acquire 100% of three German entities: impacx solutions GmbH, tel-inform solutions GmbH, and impacx services GmbH. The acquisition targets the business process outsourcing sector to expand the company's European client base. The transaction involves a base purchase price of EUR 2,000,000 and a variable earn-out capped at EUR 1,200,000 based on 2026 EBITDA performance. Completion is subject to conditions precedent and is expected by November 30, 2026. The deal is not a related party transaction and requires no governmental approvals.

voiceSummary: Fusion CX Limited will announce financial results for the second quarter of FY27 ended September 30, 2026 on Friday, 13th November 2026. An earnings conference call will be held on Monday, 16th November 2026 at 4:00 PM IST. The call will discuss the financial results and will be conducted via audio conference. Management representatives including Chairman and CEO Mr. Pankaj Dhanuka, COO Mr. Kishore Saraogi, CFO Mr. Amit Soni, and CMO Mr. Manish Jain will participate. The schedule is subject to change. Results will be available on the company website.
